caveats: Rule-based, hypothetical levels from fixed research settings. They are not predictions or advice, and no accuracy or hit rate is claimed: tests of these signals found no skill beyond chance.
A stop is a theoretical level, not an executable price: a stop order can fill worse in a sharp move or a liquidity gap.
No entry range is given: bid and ask are not in end-of-day data. Values at a price are the engine's model estimate for the data date, not quotes.

unit.note: figures per share (per unit of the position's lot multiple)

risk_boundary.meaning: the structure's value at its worst: the whole debit is lost

underlying.basis: the underlying price at which the structure reaches its planned stop and targets

greeks.review_when: net delta rises above -0.084 (30% of the entry delta -0.279)

totals.note: per share x the position's size (lot size x lots)

costs.model: the desk cost card desk-cost-v2 (services/desk_cost_card.py): brokerage, STT, exchange transaction charge, SEBI fee, stamp duty, GST and slippage, per leg and per order side, by segment (cash as equity delivery, futures, options on the premium)
costs.capital_at_risk_basis: worst net loss over all prices, every leg charged entry and exit costs; null when the loss is unbounded

iv_note: IV rank and percentile need an IV history we do not store; they are not shown.
